tagline: A sheltered UNESCO fjord with a brand-new superyacht marina — calm water tailor-made for foiling.
summary: The Bay of Kotor is a deep, sheltered UNESCO-listed ria (often called Europe's southernmost fjord) with near-flat water year-round — ideal foiling conditions. Porto Montenegro in Tivat is a purpose-built superyacht marina and one of the Adriatic's fastest-growing luxury-marine hubs, alongside Kotor's cruise port and Herceg Novi. Short, calm distances around the bay plus a short hop to Dubrovnik make it a premium Pioneer II tender-and-transfer market.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Pioneer II owns the entire Bay of Kotor — Kotor, Tivat, Perast, Herceg Novi — plus the cross-border Dubrovnik hop (~25 nm). The flat sheltered water is ideal.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Quanta-LR (H2 2026+) extends up the Montenegrin/Albanian coast and to central Dalmatia.

competitive_landscape: Porto Montenegro's megayacht fleet, Kotor cruise tenders and bay excursion boats operate today. The sheltered water and the new luxury marina are the openings; cross-border Dubrovnik links add reach. No foiling incumbent.
seasonality: Apr–Oct cruise/tourism peak; the sheltered bay supports a longer shoulder season than the open Adriatic.
regulatory_note: Montenegrin flag (EU-accession candidate, uses the euro); Porto Montenegro is the marina/berth partner; Kotor is a protected UNESCO site with cruise-management policy that favours low-impact electric craft.

precedents.why_it_matters: Kotor pairs directly with Dubrovnik (~25 nm) as a sheltered cross-border luxury bay.
